scraped.title: Export Initiative Renewable Energy
scraped.subtitle: "Export Initiative Renewable Energy": Financing Opportunities in the Frame of the "AHK Business Travel Programme for Market Development"
scraped.description: As part of the Export Initiative Renewable Energy by the German Ministry of Economics and Technology, ICON-INSTITUT was contracted to conduct studies on financing opportunities for renewable energy (RE) commercial enterprises in four countries.
body: As part of the Export Initiative Renewable Energy by the German Ministry of Economics and Technology, ICON-INSTITUT was contracted to conduct studies on financing opportunities for renewable energy (RE) commercial enterprises in four countries.

The German Government's “German Chamber of Commerce Business Travel Programme” aimed to help export-oriented companies in the RE sector gather market knowledge and establish networking opportunities. The project's objective was to support German companies with advice on financing for their commercial enterprises, including projects, exports, and factory planning, in selected foreign markets.

The project focused on four countries - Australia, Cuba, India, and Turkey - where tailored services included market analysis of financing options, presenting financing opportunities during conference events, and providing individual consulting to participating companies, with follow-up after the business trips.
